subject.name: Operating Systems
subject.description: Core operating systems concepts: processes, scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks and memory.

topics.name: Process Management
topics.description: Process lifecycle, process states, schedulers, processes and threads.
questions: What are the five states in a process lifecycle?
What is a Process Control Block?
What is the difference between long-term, short-term and medium-term schedulers?
What happens during a context switch?

topics.name: CPU Scheduling
topics.description: Preemptive and non-preemptive scheduling, scheduling algorithms.
questions: What is the difference between preemptive and non-preemptive scheduling?
What is the convoy effect in FCFS?
How does the time quantum affect Round Robin?
What is the difference between SJF and SRTF?

topics.name: Process Synchronization
topics.description: Independent and cooperative processes, synchronization, race conditions.
questions: What is a race condition?
What is the critical section problem?
Why does the lock variable mechanism fail to guarantee mutual exclusion?
What is a semaphore?

topics.name: Deadlocks
topics.description: Deadlock definition, necessary conditions, prevention, avoidance and detection.
questions: What are the four necessary conditions for deadlock?
Explain mutual exclusion and hold and wait.
What is a safe state?
What data structures does the Banker's algorithm use?

topics.name: Memory Management
topics.description: Memory allocation, paging, segmentation, virtual memory and page replacement.
questions: Explain paging and segmentation.
What is the degree of multiprogramming?
What is the difference between FIFO and LRU page replacement?
Explain virtual memory.
